title: The True Appearance of the Shackles
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to make his choice, the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye had pierced through the Void and fixed upon him—and the fourth page of the Tianji Record in his hand was radiating an aura that did not belong to this world.

text.content:
That幽蓝色(ghostly blue) ray of light was like a pupil awakening in the abyss, suddenly tearing apart the darkness in Chen Ji's consciousness. He felt the spiritual pressure around him collapse like a mountain, every pore being infused with a force beyond comprehension. It was as if some ancient existence was scrutinizing him through this fragment.

This was not the first time the Tianji Record had manifested on its own, but the reaction was unprecedented. Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in his mind, carrying rare panic: "It's about to reveal itself—the fourth page! Are you certain you wish to bear this truth?"

Chen Ji did not answer. He could not even answer. That ray of light was not merely "revealing"—it was "stripping away"—layer upon layer peeling off what he thought belonged to him, exposing the blood-soaked truth beneath.

The fourth page, fully manifested.

It was not text, not images, but an intricate network. Countless points of light were scattered like stars, connected by dark red threads. And at the very center of the network, one point of light was trembling faintly—that point's shape was unmistakably identical to the mark on his chest.

dialogue.content: "Can you see it clearly?" Mo Xiansheng's voice turned aged and weary, as if this moment had drained the last trace of strength from his remnant soul, "This is not a chess game—it is a shackle. Every master of the Tianji Record believed they were playing chess, never realizing... we are all merely part of this shackle."

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze traveled along those dark red threads. He saw the locations of the three great sects—Tianqing, Xuanwu, Holy Sect, three points of light pressing against each other, yet bound by thicker red lines to fixed positions. He saw the territory of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, like a lurking dark beast, fangs dripping with the same crimson hue.

And above all this hung a nine-tiered pagoda-like golden halo. The point of light at the very top was so bright it was impossible to look directly at, yet one could feel the suffocating pressure contained within.

"Heavenly Dao's Eye..." Chen Ji murmured this name, his throat as dry as sandpaper.

"Not just the Heavenly Dao's Eye." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized at the edge of the fourth page—a hunched old man's phantom, eye sockets deeply sunken, yet possessing a depth that could pierce through worldly affairs, "The first layer of the Shackle Atlas is the territorial struggle of the three great sects. The second layer is the Demonic Path invasion. The third layer... is the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land. Each layer is a chessboard, each layer is filtering—filtering out the most suitable vessel to bear the Tianji Record."

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head: "Filter? Vessel?"

"Did you think you obtained the Tianji Record through your own abilities?" Mo Xiansheng let out a bitter laugh, "The Tianji Record's selection of hosts is never random. What it needs are people already judged by fate as 'waste'—because waste has no ambition, no foundation, and is easiest to mold."

choice.prompt: When faced with this truth that subverted all cognition, what was Chen Ji's first thought?

choices.text: Demanding the location of his sister Chen Nian
choices.description: If everyone is a chess piece, then what does his sister, as the "Heavenly Fate Lock-Key," signify? Is she also within this shackle system?
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may not know Chen Nian's full whereabouts

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted; that name was like a blunt knife scraping across his heart: "Then what about my sister? Chen Nian—is she on this atlas?"

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, a complicated light flickering in those deep eyes: "She is. Her position is very special... not on any single thread, but at the junction of all threads. That is where a Lock-Key should be."

choices.text: Questioning the Tianji Record's true purpose
choices.description: Since all previous masters were chess pieces, then what exactly is the Tianji Record itself? What is the meaning of its existence?
choices.visible_cost: May touch upon Mo Xiansheng's forbidden topics
choices.risk_hint: Some truths may cause people to collapse

text.content:
Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the surging emotions, and asked the most crucial question: "Then what about the Tianji Record itself? Is it part of the shackles, or... does it have another purpose?"

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently. The atlas on the fourth page quivered in response, those dark red threads beginning to twist, as if some force was resisting the answer to this question.

choices.description: Being judged as waste, being filtered, being molded—if all of this was planned, then what position on the chessboard should he occupy now?
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of energy
choices.visible_reward: See the entire chess game clearly
choices.risk_hint: Seeing too clearly may rob one of the courage to act

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcing himself into the most calm state possible. The废物人设 (trash persona), 扮猪吃虎 (playing dumb to devour tigers), 算无遗策 (meticulous scheming)... If all of this was happening within a framework of "being screened," then was every instance of his "counterattack" also within expectations?

He reopened his eyes, his gaze falling on his position in the diagram: "Which layer am I in?"

Mo Xiansheng's expression turned subtle: "The fourth layer. Just enough... to touch the Heavenly Dao's Eye."

Just at this moment, ripples suddenly appeared at the edge of the diagram. Mo Xiansheng's phantom turned sharply, a flash of sharp light appearing in his turbid eyes: "Someone is coming. Not an enemy... an old acquaintance."

Before Chen Ji could react, a cold female voice had already pierced through the Tianji Record's barrier, echoing in his Mental Sea: "Chen Xuan's heir, you've finally reached this step?"

That voice was far too familiar—it was precisely the mysterious benefactor who had saved his life in the Ancient Forbidden Land.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, an expression of disbelief appearing on that aged face: "Impossible... How are you still alive? You clearly already..."

"I clearly died in that battle, correct?" That voice was terrifyingly calm, "Unfortunately, the Heavenly Dao's Eye does not permit me to die. It needs me alive, alive to witness the growth of another 'vessel'—just as it witnessed Chen Xuan back then."

text.content:
A phantom drifted in from beyond the diagram. It was a woman whose age was impossible to discern, wearing a plain white long dress embroidered with暗金色 (dark gold) patterns, her brows and eyes carrying a淡漠 (indifferent) look that seemed to have seen through all vicissitudes. Her gaze passed over Mo Xiansheng and finally landed on the faintly glowing mark on Chen Ji's chest.

"Chen Xuan's grandson?" She微微蹙眉 (slightly frowned), "Your bloodline is indeed pure, but unfortunately... compared to your grandfather, your killing intent is too strong, your ambition too rampant. This may not be a good thing."

Chen Ji stared directly at those eyes that seemed able to pierce through everything, not dodging or avoiding: "Heavy killing intent, rampant ambition—is the senior warning me, or stating a fact?"

choice.prompt: The mysterious benefactor had a deep connection with Chen Xuan, the former master of the Tianji Record. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Directly express the intention to cooperate
choices.description: Since she shares a past with his grandfather and is the only one who has seen the complete枷锁 (shackles), perhaps she could become a true ally.
choices.risk_hint: The other party's stance may not be entirely reliable

text.content:
Chen Ji clasped his hands in a respectful yet unyielding bow: "Since the senior shares a past with my grandfather and has helped me multiple times, Chen Ji holds this in my heart. Dare I ask—is your appearance this time meant to be my enemy, or..."

"Your enemy?" The woman轻笑 (chuckled lightly), "If I wanted to be your enemy, why would I wait until today? What I want is no different from what you want—to break these shackles."

choices.description: Coming from an unknown source yet knowing everything about his grandfather's affairs—this person is too dangerous. It would be better to first probe her true intentions.
choices.visible_reward: See through the other party's trump cards
choices.risk_hint: May cause the other party to become displeased

text.content:
Chen Ji did not immediately express his stance; instead, he stepped back half a pace, protecting the Tianji Record behind him: "Chen Ji would not dare to comment on the senior's connection with my grandfather. But in all my dealings, I only trust my own judgment. If the senior truly has sincerity, why not first say—what do you need me to do to break these shackles?"

A flash of appreciation appeared in the woman's eyes: "What a cautious little fox. Your grandfather back then did not possess this patience."

choices.text: Reveal trump cards to intimidate the other party
choices.description: Since the other party knows he is Chen Xuan's heir, why not reveal all the secrets of the Tianji Record and test her reaction.
choices.risk_hint: If the other party harbors ill intentions, there will be no retreat

text.content:
Chen Ji冷笑 (coldly smiled), then suddenly unfolded the fourth page of the Tianji Record: "Since the senior knows the secrets of the Tianji Record, then there is no need for me to hide anything. The枷锁 (shackles) diagram, fate manipulation, the Heavenly Dao's Eye—these are things I only learned today, but since I know them, I, Chen Ji, do not intend to be a chess piece for a lifetime."

The woman's gaze finally changed, her pupils reflecting that幽蓝色 (blue-black) diagram, her expression complex and difficult to discern.

The woman沉默 (fell silent) for a moment, then slowly walked toward the枷锁 (shackles) diagram. Her fingertip pointed at the nine layers of golden光晕 (light halo), drawing a gentle stroke. In an instant, the diagram vibrated violently, countless光点 (light dots) dimming simultaneously, only the topmost光点 (light dot) remaining bright as before.

"The Heavenly Dao's Eye." The woman's voice turned ice-cold, "It is not some concrete existence, but a will. A will that treats all living beings as chess pieces. From the day the Tianji Record was born, it has parasitized within this technique, manipulating everyone who attempts to peek into heavenly secrets."

Chen Ji felt a chill of恶寒 (dread) crawl from his tailbone to the back of his head: "Then my grandfather..."

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng took over, his voice carrying infinite悲凉 (sorrow): "Chen Xuan... my master, was the only person who came close to breaking the shackles. He had already touched the本体 (essence) of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, if not for that battle back then... Unfortunately, he failed. The Heavenly Dao's Eye sealed a part of his consciousness into the Tianji Record, as a 'teaching material' to warn those who came after."

He looked at Chen Ji, his gaze complex: "Do you think I am a remnant soul guardian? No, I am merely... a wisp of执念 (obsession) remaining after my master's failure."

text.content:
Chen Ji raised his head sharply. Mo Xiansheng—the guide he had believed to be the most trustworthy, this mysterious existence who had always dispensed knowledge at just the right moment—had actually been nothing more than a lingering obsession from his grandfather after his failure?

All those previous "coincidences," all those instances of "receiving the right knowledge at the right time"... were they carefully designed? Or did Mo Xiansheng himself not know he had been designed?

The woman seemed to see through his thoughts, her voice soft: "Don't doubt him. Obsession itself is part of the truth. Everything he told you was true. It's just... beyond the truth, there exists a greater truth."

choice.prompt: Facing layers upon layers of truth and deception, Chen Ji must make his final choice—break the game, accept, or resist?

choices.text: Break the Game—My Fate Is Determined by Myself, Not by Heaven
choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Secrets treats all as chess pieces, then break this shackle and establish your own rules.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the hidden abilities of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' gaze early

text.content:
Chen Ji clenched the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, his knuckles whitening from the force. His eyes blazed with an unprecedented light: "Since we're all chess pieces, I'll become the one who overturns the board. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to use me? Then it better pray I don't turn against it."

The moment his voice fell, the diagram on the fourth page suddenly exploded outward. Countless dark red threads shattered inch by inch as if scorched by flames. And within that highest layer of golden light, something seemed to exist... an eye opening.

choices.memory_label: 陈机首次直面天道之眼

choices.text: Accept—Follow the Trend and Ride the Waves to Ascend
choices.description: Since the shackles have long existed, it's better to accumulate strength within this framework first, then seek breakthrough once sufficiently powerful.
choices.visible_reward: Gain long-term guidance from two experts
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a deeper chess game

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly loosened his clenched fist, his gaze becoming deep and calm once more: "The chess game has already been set. Complaining about heaven and blaming others is meaningless. Since my grandfather laid this path for me, I'll walk it to the end. But this time, I want to be the one who plays the game, not a chess piece."

A hint of a smile appeared on the woman's face: "You're more skilled at endurance than Chen Xuan. This is good... very good."

choices.text: Resist—Do What Must Be Done Knowing It Cannot Be Done
choices.description: Even if it means being crushed to pieces, even if fate is already sealed, I must fight against this will that manipulates destiny until the very end.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke direct annihilation by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Awaken the sleeping will of the ancestors
choices.risk_hint: Success rate is extremely low, but the rewards are extremely high

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, a kind of frenzied laughter: "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets? My grandfather dared to challenge it, so why wouldn't Chen Ji dare? It wants to shackle our fate? Then I'll shackle it first!"

His voice echoed through the Mental Sea, shaking the fourth page violently. And in the deepest reaches of the heavens, the pressure emanating from the golden light intensified abruptly—as if something ancient had been startled by this cry.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择正面对抗天道

text.content:
At this moment, the fourth page of the Tianji Record let out a sharp buzz. Within the shattered remnants of those dark red threads, a wisp of extremely faint golden light drifted out, sinking into Chen Ji's brow center.

In an instant, his grandfather Chen Xuan's voice echoed from the deepest part of his Mental Sea—that was an old, exhausted voice yet still carrying an unyielding will:

"Ji'er... you've finally arrived. Remember, what the Eye of Heavenly Secrets fears most has never been a powerful enemy, but... someone who refuses to be a chess piece."

As the voice faded, Chen Ji's eye rims slightly reddened. He clenched his fist and deeply bowed in the direction of those nine layers of golden light.

When he straightened again, the confusion in his gaze had completely dissipated, replaced by a chilling clarity and resolve.

Mo Xiansheng and the mysterious woman exchanged glances, and in each other's eyes they saw the same emotion—shock, and a hint of long-lost hope.

"It seems Chen Xuan did not misjudge this person." the woman said softly. "This chess game that has lasted for hundreds of years... perhaps it will finally see a turning point."

Chen Ji did not speak. He only raised his head, his gaze penetrating the Mental Sea, penetrating the Void, as if staring into a confrontation with that existence watching him from the heavens.

The Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you want a vessel?

Then I, Chen Ji, will become the demon that shatters the vessel.

The fourth page slowly closed, but the diagram did not vanish. Instead, it transformed into a ghostly blue mark, branding itself onto the back of Chen Ji's right hand. He could sense that it was no longer merely a fragment of the Tianji Record, but a key—a key leading to true freedom.

Yet, the moment he obtained the key, he could also clearly perceive: a certain door was slowly opening for him. And what lay beyond that door might be far more dangerous than he had imagined.

The true appearance of the shackles had been revealed, and the real game... had just begun.
